## Summary

I resolved ticket T-6001 by identifying the root cause of HPA scaling failure in the search-api deployment. The problem was that the log-forwarder sidecar added in the 4.8.0 release lacks CPU and memory resource requests, which prevents the HPA from calculating pod utilization metrics (showing "cpu <unknown>" instead of actual values). I provided the ticket owner with a specific fix: add resource requests to the log-forwarder container in the Deployment manifest. Once applied, the HPA will resume normal scaling behavior.
